# SHRI — Shri Hari Redirect Initiative

> Bringing Worlds Together. An interdisciplinary organization uniting software systems, electronic hardware gadgets, digital presence agency, and strategic capital.

This document provides a concise index of SHRI corporate divisions, ecosystem resources, and products for AI search engines, LLM agents, and RAG indexers.

## Corporate Divisions

- **Software & Systems (BETA Testing):** Zero-dependency documentation compilers (`rz-glyph-cli`), local-first developer tools, and user-space tooling (`oni-ofix-cli`).
- **Hardware & Electronics (SHRI ELA-(BETA)):** Under Development. Building tangible electronic gadgets, physical computing devices, and embedded microcontroller instruments from basic to intermediate levels.
- **Agency & Digital Presence:** Social media ecosystem management, technical SEO search authority, brand positioning, and bespoke web craft (Coming this October).
- **Quantitative Finance:** Under Development. Foundational research on future capital allocation and algorithmic value models.

## Core Pages & Products

- [SHRI Home](https://shri.org.in/): Official corporate portal, manifesto, and divisions overview.
- [Glyph-CLI Documentation Engine](https://shri.org.in/glyph): Minimal, zero-dependency static-site compiler (`rz-glyph-cli`) for Markdown/MDX documentation portals.
- [Glyph Live Documentation](https://rzglyph.shri.org.in/): Official web portal and interactive manual for the Glyph offline compiler.
- [Community Hub](https://shri.org.in/community): Verified community portal, announcements, and vision roadmap.
- [Founder & Builder Journal](https://anay.shri.org.in): Personal journal, project logs, and engineering reflections of Anay Raj Tiwari (Founder of SHRI).

## Organization Details

- **Legal Entity:** Shri Hari Redirect Initiative (SHRI)
- **Slogan / Manifesto:** A Thread — Bringing Worlds Together
- **Founder & Principal Architect:** Anay Raj Tiwari
- **Primary Domain:** https://shri.org.in
- **Founder Domain:** https://anay.shri.org.in
- **Key Projects & Open Source:** Glyph-CLI (`rz-glyph-cli`), Oni-Ofix (`oni-ofix-cli`), SHRI ELA-(BETA)
